list.title: Repairs
list.lead: Tell the building office what needs fixing. You get a LINE message each time the request moves on.
list.emptyBody: When something in your unit breaks, report it here with a few photos.

new.title: Report a problem
new.lead: Describe the problem and add photos — the office and the technician see exactly what you see.
new.urgencyHint: Urgent is for water leaking, no power, or a door that will not lock.
new.descriptionHint: Where it is and what happens, for example "the bathroom tap drips all the time".
new.descriptionMissing: Write a few words about the problem
new.photosHint: Up to {max} photos. They help the technician bring the right parts.
new.preferredVisit: When is a good time for a visit?
new.noCategories: This building does not take repair requests in the app yet. Please call the office.
new.sent: Request {ref} sent. The office will be in touch.

detail.title: Request {ref}
detail.photoCount: {count, plural, one {# photo sent} other {# photos sent}}
detail.warrantyTitle: Sent to the developer under warranty
detail.warrantyBody: Your unit is still under the developer's warranty, so the building passed this request to them. You will hear from them or from the office.
detail.confirmVisitLead: Will you be home then? Please confirm. If the office moves the visit, you will be asked again.
detail.visitConfirmedToast: Thanks — the technician knows you'll be there.

sla.title: Response time
sla.on_track: The office aims to fix this by {date}
sla.at_risk: Due soon: the office aims to fix this by {date}
sla.breached: Taking longer than planned (target was {date}). The office has been reminded.
sla.paused: Paused while the developer handles it under warranty

detail.ratingShown: You rated {rating, plural, one {# star} other {# stars}}

cancel.title: Cancel this request?
cancel.body: The office stops working on it. You can report the problem again later.
cancel.reasonDefault: Fixed it myself / no longer needed

rate.title: How did it go?
rate.lead: Your rating closes the request and helps the building choose good technicians.

thread.title: Messages
thread.lead: Talk to the office and the technician here. Your phone number is never shown.
thread.label: Message
thread.closed: This request is closed; messages are read-only.
